sources: Numbeo, Quality of Life Index by Country 2026 Mid-Year and Cost of Living Index by Country 2026 Mid-Year (screenshots 17.11.2026; crowd-sourced user data). 89 countries with all values. Weather = Climate Index (top: Uruguay 98.0, Malta 97.9, Portugal 97.8); safety = Safety Index (UAE 86.3, Qatar 84.8, Taiwan 82.9); food = Groceries Index, lowest (Pakistan 18.8, India 21.4, Iran 21.4); pay = (Local) Purchasing Power Index (Kuwait 179.7, Qatar 173.5, Switzerland 168.7); rent = Rent Index, lowest (Bangladesh 2.4, Pakistan 3.1, India 3.8). Block height = percentile rank among the 89 countries.
